title: RAG-TRACE: Tracing Measurement Evidence and Diagnostic Completeness in AI-Generated ECG Reports
abstract: arXiv:2611.01409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can introduce electrocardiogram (ECG) criteria that lack patient-specific measurement support. This study evaluates the reliability of retrieved diagnostic criteria in AI-generated ECG reports. Methods: We analyzed 1,083 human-validated PTB-XL patient records using a library of 47 criteria cards, including 33 without numeric verification rules. Language models generated structured reports with and without retrieval. Criterion applicability was evaluated using Marquette 12SL measurements, with independent assessment using Uni-G and comparison against expert-validated diagnostic labels. Results: Keyword retrieval introduced untestable or measurement-disconfirmed criteria in 46.8% of GPT-4.1-mini reports. translated_title: RAG-TRACE：追踪AI生成心电图报告中的测量证据与诊断完整性
translated_abstract: 目的：检索增强生成（RAG）可能引入缺乏患者特异性测量支持的心电图（ECG）诊断标准。本研究评估了AI生成的心电图报告中检索所得诊断标准的可靠性。方法：我们分析了1,083条经人工验证的PTB-XL患者记录，使用包含47张标准卡的规则库，其中33张没有数值验证规则。语言模型在有检索和无检索两种条件下生成结构化报告。标准适用性使用Marquette 12SL测量值进行评估，并使用Uni-G进行独立评估，同时与专家验证的诊断标签进行比较。结果：关键词检索在46.8%的GPT-4.1-mini报告中引入了无法检测或与测量结果相矛盾的诊断标准。一条确定性验证规则撤销了647项标准应用，其中包括639项无数值检查依据的应用，同时保留了269项独立获得Uni-G支持的应用中的268项。限制：（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出RAG-TRACE方法，通过追踪测量证据发现关键词检索会在AI生成的心电图报告中引入大量缺乏患者特异性测量支持的不可靠诊断标准，而确定性数值验证规则能有效撤销这些错误标准应用，同时保留有真实依据的诊断。
en_tdlr: RAG-TRACE reveals that keyword retrieval introduces substantial untestable or measurement-disconfirmed diagnostic criteria in AI-generated ECG reports, while a deterministic verification rule effectively withdraws these unsupported criterion applications while preserving genuinely evidence-backed ones.
